# Where to Watch Mary 4 Mayor


by Angel | October 27, 2026


Mary has a plan to help her struggling hometown find a fresh start. With her high school friends backing her, she decides to run for mayor against her own father. But as Mary and her team work to make their campaign promise, “We Can Do Better!” a reality, they discover that someone may be working behind the scenes to keep their town from changing.


With family rivalries, loyal friendships, and a community in need of hope, *Mary 4 Mayor* is a family-friendly movie about standing up for what matters.[Watch it now, exclusively on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/mary-4-mayor)


### **When Your Opponent Is Your Own Father**


Running for mayor is challenging enough without going up against someone you know so well. For Mary, the race becomes personal when she discovers that her biggest political opponent is her own father.


Their rivalry adds another layer to Mary’s mission. As she fights for the future she believes her town deserves, she also has to navigate the complicated relationship between family loyalty and standing up for what she believes is right.


### **A Feel-Good Story About Standing Up for Change**


With a mix of humor, heart, and small-town challenges, *Mary 4 Mayor* offers a story about taking initiative and believing a better future is possible. Mary’s campaign may start with a plan to change her town, but the people and obstacles she encounters make the journey about much more than winning an election.


Angel Guild members have praised the film for its positive messages, family-friendly story, and themes of unity and forgiveness. Whether you’re looking for a feel-good movie night or a story the whole family can enjoy together, Mary’s journey offers plenty to talk about.


### **Watch** ***Mary 4 Mayor*** **on Angel**


Can Mary and her friends make their vision for a better hometown a reality when someone is working against them—and her own father stands in the way?


Find out in *Mary 4 Mayor* , a heartwarming story about family, friendship, and the courage to make a difference.


[Stream Mary 4 Mayor now, exclusively on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/mary-4-mayor)
